_comment: Baseline VpScaleRender renderer settings, copied from the TrainKit r2 tools/scaling_render.json (locked set) so the sweep never reads the kit at run time. 'down'/'up' are the hybrid scalers' settings; 'shaders' are the shader profiles selected after Build.
shader_sections:
[shader.standard]
type: multi
label: Off
[shader.standard.ssim_downscaler]
shader_type: custom
label: SSimDownscaler
stage: post_resize
order: 20
glsl_file: SSimDownscaler.glsl
[shader.standard.fsrcnnx]
shader_type: custom
label: FSRCNNX upscaler
stage: pre_resize
order: 15
glsl_file: FSRCNNX_x2_16-0-4-1.glsl
[shader.standard.ssim_superres]
shader_type: custom
label: SSimSuperRes (upscale refinement)
stage: post_resize
order: 25
glsl_file: SSimSuperRes.glsl
